## What's new

- Page visibility and Bookshelf sources in Settings show two options per row. Account and tool actions remain full-width.
- Book covers no longer show source badges. Continue Reading has a slightly larger cover and keeps its horizontal layout; Recent remains unchanged.
- Apps and Bookshelf retain four columns. Browsing a local folder no longer moves it to the front, and refreshes preserve the visible shelf position.
- Previously downloaded update APKs can be installed without another download after verification.
